scripts.predev: npm run build:eliza -w @switchboard/sdk && npm run prisma:generate
scripts.dev:test: dotenv -e packages/web/.env.test -e packages/web/.env -e .env -c -- npm run dev -w @switchboard/web
scripts.predev:electron: npm run build:eliza -w @switchboard/sdk && npm run prisma:generate && npm run build -w @switchboard/desktop
scripts.dev:electron: dotenv -e packages/desktop/.env -e packages/web/.env -e .env -c -- sh -c 'npm run dev -w @switchboard/web & sleep 3 && electron packages/desktop/dist/main.js'
scripts.prisma:migrate: dotenv -e packages/web/.env -e .env -c -- npm exec -w @switchboard/web -- prisma migrate dev
scripts.prisma:migrate:deploy: dotenv -e packages/web/.env -e .env -c -- npm exec -w @switchboard/web -- prisma migrate deploy
scripts.prisma:generate: dotenv -e packages/web/.env -e .env -c -- npm exec -w @switchboard/web -- prisma generate
scripts.prisma:status: dotenv -e packages/web/.env -e .env -c -- npm exec -w @switchboard/web -- prisma migrate status
scripts.build: dotenv -e packages/web/.env -e .env -c -- sh -c 'npm run build -w @switchboard/sdk && npm run build -w @switchboard/web'
scripts.build:web: npm run build:sdk && npm run prisma:generate && dotenv -e packages/web/.env -e .env -c -- npm run build -w @switchboard/web
scripts.start:electron: dotenv -e packages/desktop/.env -e packages/web/.env -e .env -c -- sh -c 'BACKGROUND_AGENTS_URL="${BACKGROUND_AGENTS_URL:-https://switchboard.local}" npm run start -w @switchboard/desktop'
scripts.vercel-build: npm run build --workspaces --if-present --workspace @switchboard/common --workspace @switchboard/agent-configuration --workspace @switchboard/claude-credentials --workspace @switchboard/mcp --workspace @switchboard/sandbox-git --workspace @switchboard/sandbox-jobs --workspace @switchboard/sandbox-skills --workspace @switchboard/sandbox-terminal --workspace @switchboard/sdk && npm run build -w @switchboard/web
